summary: The Isle of Dorn is the green surface of Khaz Algar, west of Pandaria and southeast of Kalimdor: waterfalls, ironwood forest and open mountain country with the earthen city of Dornogal at its middle. The Council of Dornogal governs it, and the villages around them are earthen too, with kobolds squatting in a hillside graveyard, fungarians in the southern basin and nerubians dug into a mine on the north shore. Dalaran's wreckage lies along the Tranquil Strand, which is what brought both factions here.
history: When the Elemental Lords ruled the world and this was still part of Kalimdor, the land answered to Al'Akir. The titans' surveyors filed it as Sector AR-938 and sent a contingent of earthen to look into an anomaly in a fissure. What the keepers got back was unsettling: those earthen began behaving like the ones taken by the curse of flesh, though they had never met them and shared nothing with them. Archaedas set the watchers Dornic and Galan over them, and the earthen eventually rose against Dornic for how he treated them. They named the place Khaz Algar and were left alone with it for thousands of years — until a magical city fell out of the sky onto their beach.
factions: Algari earthen and the Council of Dornogal
